scientific_integrity: The contact-process model is established prior work. The all-size quadratic graph-motif expansion and positive wedge coefficient are the candidate contribution. Exact small-graph extinction times in the literature already contain corresponding small-case coefficients; independent historical priority and external validation are not established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite simple undirected graphs, independent exponentially timed local extinctions, additive edge recolonization, full occupancy at time zero, and rates near zero. No claim for large graphs, global rankings at moderate rates, or empirical parameter estimation.
title: The universal wedge law for weak-colonization extinction times
